name: Combinatorial Eluder Dimension of the Three-Code Class
proof: Use $000$ as base.  First query the first coordinate with witness $101$; then query the second coordinate with witness $011$, which agrees with the base at the first coordinate.  This gives a length-two eluder sequence.  Such witnesses are distinct and cannot equal the base, so a class of three concepts admits no sequence longer than two.  Thus the value is two.
